quickref.name: Sky View
quickref.era: BBG launch, May 2013: one of the trailer's '3 New Maps' with Gold Digger and Skate or Die [Canon]. The wiki calls it the '2.0 update' (= BBG launch) [Fan-wiki]. Not in BBR [Canon per notes]. Pre-launch teaser B-1000.jpg posted 2013-05-15 [Fan-wiki/Observed]. No documented rework. Game-wide 'New Map Lighting' in BBG 3.0, Nov 15, 2021 [Game text via wiki]
quickref.in_2026: Not named in the Steam text [Canon]. Soundtrack track 3 'Sky View' (1:03) [Canon]. In SkyVu's 'BBG Maps Ranked part 1' (Oct 11, 2026): one of the 16 map stills, plus a gameplay frame that places it in the '13-16' tier row [Observed in thumbnails]. Probably in the launch game [Inference]; modes unknown. Not the same as the new 'Sky World' = Sky Pirates map [Canon]
quickref.setting: Construction site on the open top floor of an unfinished skyscraper: a red steel skeleton rising above a rooftop in a 'nondescript city' of office towers [Fan-wiki; Observed; Canon per notes, unverified]. First urban/rooftop BBG map [Fan-wiki]. Name probably a SkyVu pun [Fan-wiki]
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Dusk turning to night: navy sky #092A4D with small stars, a magenta-rose band #92435C-#C46770 and a peach-pink horizon glow #E0B8AC. Red-oxide beams #5C211C, black grating #231E1B, blond planks #A77844-#B47D47, glossy blue tarps #1FBDB8 (highlight #39F0E7), crane yellow #FADB29, warm grey-white towers #907E69. Low, warm, soft light; no weather [Observed]. Shares Gold Digger's skybox [Fan-wiki]
quickref.landmarks: Yellow lattice tower crane with a hook hanging over the deck; glossy blue construction tarps on posts, including the big one across the middle; red I-beam grid with black grating, open holes and plank walkways; an edgeless deck high above office towers; magenta sunset over a starry navy sky; a pale faceted round tower by the crane [Observed; Fan-wiki]
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: No walls at the edges and many gaps: falling into the city counts as suicide; some spawns face the edge [Fan-wiki]. Smallest, single-level map; spawns close together with thin cover [Fan-wiki]. No jump pads [Fan-wiki]. Pickups: Bearscream Sandwich by the central tarp on Blue's side, Imperial Basket Grande on a ramp (wiki pages conflict on count and position), Health Pack and Shield beside planks at each spawn [Fan-wiki]. PTB bombs on opposite sides of the central tarp [Fan-wiki]. Old 'stuck in the ramp' glitch [Fan-wiki]. Gold Digger's out-of-bounds shows Sky View's buildings [Fan-wiki]

corrections.current_text: - The wiki's Sky View page says the three maps came "on the 2.0 update" [Fan-wiki]. But the wiki's version tables go 1.0 → 1.0.1 → 1.0.2 → 2.1 with no 2.0 [Fan-wiki]. "2.0" probably means the launch build [Inference]; this is unresolved.
corrections.correction: Resolved. The wiki's own Battle Bears Gold gallery calls the BBG launch build '2.0': 'Before 2.0 splash screen' (BBR splash), 'The first 2.0 loading screen' (BBG loading screen uploaded 2013-06-06) and 'discarded as of version 2.0' for the old BBR icon. The Versions table labels the same May 24, 2013 release '1.0'. So '2.0 update' means the BBG launch [Fan-wiki; two numbering schemes]. The trailer published 2013-05-30 lists the three maps as BBG launch content [Canon].
corrections.evidence: Battle Bears Gold page wikitext via the MediaWiki API (gallery captions). File:Battle_Bears_Gold_loading_screen.jpg imageinfo timestamp 2013-06-06T16:11:24Z. Wiki video record File:BATTLE BEARS GOLD Trailer Award-Winning Multiplayer Shooter Game, metadata published 1369947857 (2013-05-30 UTC), description '3 New Maps: -Gold Digger -Skate or Die -Sky View'.
